_comment: door_chain_fight's start -- the FULL end-to-end FIGHT-leg canonical (the 'route is the subject' script per FIXTURE-FIRST POLICY's own exception; it USED to prove Erin's beat-1 flicker line fired for real; since the 2026-07-26 restructure it proves the MOUNTING scene does). CONSTRAINT: post_game structurally implies the FULL Act II/III backbone (acts.json's counted_among beat; test_fixture_coherence.gd enforces it), so this fixture carries the near_act3/climax_sealed_start Act III-complete shape alongside the harness-tuned 'warrior5_mage5' build -- this is the one door-chain fixture whose OWN canonical resolves real fights at a pinned seed, so the combat-relevant fields (classes, weapon, rng_state) are exactly the tuned/measured ones (test_fixture_coherence.gd's exact-build combat-band check pins the 10-level total). met_relc banked so Relc fields as an ally in both live fights (rift_vermin_leak/ruin_guardian ship allies:[relc]/ally_requires:{met_relc:1}, matching the gated 0.55-0.95/0.55-0.8 cells rather than the harder ungated _solo variants). Task 2.2's interim fixture-banked start is GONE (see _comment_task_2_4 above): this canonical plays the MOUNTING SCENE live again, so `door_chain_started` and started_quests' door_that_goes_elsewhere are both unbanked here and earned in-run at Pisces's door_mounting conversation. door_understood/pedestal_unsealed/recovered_anchor_stone/etc. likewise stay UNBANKED: everything from the mounting onward is played for real. gold 40 (position ledger's Tier-A honest Act III income (docs/design/fixture-position-ledger.md), pre-catalyst-spend) covers Krshia's 35g catalyst with headroom. Equipped `relcs_spare_spear` (the tutorial gift) over the starter rusty_sword -- warrior's own L1 grants BOTH power_strike (sword) and piercing_strikes (spear), so the family swap only trades one weapon-tagged skill for its sibling; both live fights (rift_vermin_leak, ruin_guardian) land victories at this exact rng_state with the spear equipped. times_slept 12 (cosmetic -- only rotates the request/delivery board slate, never visited by this canonical). rng_state governs both live fights. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=3, captured .state = -7684921244414978279), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. RE-DERIVED (issue #83): ruin_ward_a/b's `guard` adoption made the ruin_guardian fight measurably harder (sim_combat_batch.gd's ruin_guardian_w8_relc win_rate 0.69 -> 0.59 after the accompanying combatants.json retune) -- the OLD .seed=1 state (-1966449618399012673) still won rift_vermin_leak but now LOST ruin_guardian at this exact draw, so a fresh state was seed-searched (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd) until BOTH live fights won again; .seed=3 was the first candidate to also hold for door_chain_sequence_break_start's own opposite-order run (see that fixture's own TRAP comment) and was kept for both together.
_comment_task_2_3: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.3): horns_dig_started + horns_dig_joined added. anchor_stone_pedestal's contains_when now also gates on horns_dig_joined (quests.json horns_dig's no-cosmetic-skip rule), so this legacy door-chain position only opens the pedestal as a POST-BACKFILL save does -- Task 2.6 banks exactly these two for any old chain save. The pedestal open here now also banks pedestal_breached + door_retrieved; that is the same one-event canon (you cannot hold the anchor stone without having breached and retrieved).
_comment_task_2_4: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.4) -- THE WAVE'S FIXTURE RULE, stated once here and referenced by every other swept fixture. `door_chain_started` is now a LEGACY ALIAS banked on the same dialogue option as `door_mounted` (data/dialogue/door_mounting.json), so it no longer means 'Erin mentioned her door' -- it means THE MAGICAL DOOR IS HUNG AT THE INN. A fixture holding it without door_mounted therefore asserts an impossible save, and test_fixture_coherence.gd now enforces the implication. THE SWEEP: every fixture that needs the door chain live carries door_mounted + door_retrieved + pedestal_breached + horns_dig_started + horns_dig_joined (the haul that produced the door); fixtures that only ever wanted the old Erin-option side effect DROP the counter (wave_b_animate_start, standing mid-dig on the ruin surface, is the one such case). `recovered_anchor_stone` is deliberately NOT swept in: the pedestal banks it atomically with door_retrieved for a fresh player, but Task 2.6's backfill banks the dig counters for an old chain save that never went to the ruin -- so door_retrieved WITHOUT recovered_anchor_stone is exactly the post-backfill migrated position, which is what the door_chain_talk/scout/sequence_break canonicals now stand in (they still fetch the anchor stone live, and must, because the awakening sleep-beat still requires it). THIS FIXTURE IS THE ONE EXCEPTION IN THE OTHER DIRECTION: door_chain_started and started_quests' door_that_goes_elsewhere are GONE from it, because door_chain_fight now plays the mounting scene -- the chain's real start -- LIVE (controller ruling, replacing Task 2.2's interim fixture-banked start). It holds door_retrieved WITHOUT door_mounted: the haul is home and leaning against the pantry frame, and the first thing the script does is have Pisces hang it. Repositioned from (7,3) (facing Erin, where the retired beat-1 leg began) to (13,4), one cell north of `pisces_mounting` (13,5), so the script bumps south into him for facing. NO RNG CONSEQUENCE: the added leg is dialogue only, both live fights keep their original order (rift_vermin_leak then ruin_guardian) and therefore their original draws off this same unchanged rng_state.
